text: 2026-08-03 parity decision: the standalone S07 R design receipt pins both builders to explicit 0.1-second convolution precision. At the current default 0.3-second fast Conv/FFT precision, an off-grid impulse is quantized differently: for onset 12 and acquisition sample 12.5, Scala produced 0.0035548769 while current R fmrihrf C++ interpolation produced 0.002419903. This is a real temporal-discretization/backend convention gap, not a failed test to hide. Future acceptance must either assign a documented convention ID and scope parity accordingly, or implement interpolation and add regression fixtures; default R parity is not yet exact.
